title: List the name of leagues in which the average goals by the home team is hig
question:
List the name of leagues in which the average goals by the home team is higher than the away team in the 2009/2010 season.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: name of league refers to League.name; average goals by the home team is higher than the away team = AVG(home_team_goal) > AVG(away_team_goal); AVG(xx_goal) = SUM(xx_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id); 2009/2010 season refers to season = '2009/2010'

prediction.sql:
SELECT L.XCL_005
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY L.XCL_003, L.XCL_005
HAVING SUM(M.XCL_015) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT M.XCL_006) > SUM(M.XCL_016) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT M.XCL_006);
